assets.name: Maçã Vermelha (Soft Clay)
assets.prompt: A single fresh crisp red apple, soft 3D clay aesthetic, tactile smooth geometry with subtle warm lighting, centered on a clean pure neutral white background, high contrast, perfect for a pediatric clinical matching app.
assets.clinicalUse: Pareamento idêntico e categorização alimentar no jogo Encontre o Igual / Match Lab.

assets.name: Bananas Maduras (Soft Clay)
assets.prompt: A bunch of ripe yellow bananas, soft 3D clay aesthetic, smooth rounded shapes with gentle organic curves, clean neutral white background, centered composition, high visual clarity for pediatric matching.
assets.clinicalUse: Discriminação visual e resposta de ouvinte em Pequeno Chef e Encontre o Igual.

assets.name: Carrinho Azul (Soft Clay)
assets.prompt: A cute little bright blue toy passenger car, soft 3D clay aesthetic, chunky rounded friendly wheels and windows, centered on pure neutral white background, playful tactile style, pediatric learning visual.
assets.clinicalUse: Pareamento funcional e categoria de veículos em Encontre o Igual.

assets.name: Escovar os Dentes
assets.prompt: Toothbrush with child-safe blue ergonomic handle and soft bristles topped with a dollop of white and red striped toothpaste, soft 3D volumetric shading.
assets.clinicalUse: Cartão visual para rotina AVD e estúdio de análise de tarefas.

assets.name: Lavar as Mãos
assets.prompt: Gentle cartoon hands under soft water droplets with soap suds, warm reassuring palette, clear step visual for hand hygiene routine.
assets.clinicalUse: Cartão para Primeira Tarefa (Premack) e rotina de autocuidado.

assets.name: Folha de Personagem: Leo
assets.prompt: Character expression sheet of a young friendly child with expressive facial cues (happy, attentive, calm), soft clay styling.
assets.clinicalUse: Avatar e modelo de imitação facial no jogo Espelho Mágico.

assets.name: Ambiente Adolescente: Cafeteria
assets.prompt: Cozy minimal cafe interior with warm lighting, wood tables, calm seating area, designed for social interaction rehearsal for neurodivergent teens.
assets.clinicalUse: Cenário de treino de habilidades sociais para o modo adolescente e Social City.

assets.name: Avatar de Imitação Infantil
assets.prompt: Stylized smiling child avatar facing front, friendly large eyes, calm pastel tones, designed for imitation training.
assets.clinicalUse: Feedback de espelhamento motor e emocional no Espelho Mágico.
